steps.title: Enemies that fight back
steps.body: Every enemy in the Starter pack now fights in its own way, the way Zelda's enemies do: a Pebblespout pops out of the ground and spits rocks you can bounce back with your shield, a Watcher Eye fires a beam you can block, a Lanternwisp fades out of sight until you look through the Lens of Truth, and Howlers hunt as a pack. They are in Starter pack › Cast.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: Sword and shield
steps.body: Rook carries a sword and a shield. Hold Q to put the shield up toward what you face: it blocks a hit from the front, and a rock that hits it bounces back.
steps.task: Make Rook the player character (Hero › Play as).

steps.title: A Pebblespout
steps.body: Place a Pebblespout about 9 studs ahead of the start. It waits under the ground with only its top showing. When you stand a few studs away it comes up, spits a rock in an arc that lands where you stand, and ducks back down. Up close it stays hidden.

steps.title: Bounce the rock back
steps.body: Press Play and stand in front of it, about 8 studs away. Hold Q, facing it, while it spits: the rock bounces off the shield straight back at it, faster, and hits it twice as hard as it would hit you. Without the shield up the rock hurts you.
steps.task: Press Play and bounce a rock back at the Pebblespout.

steps.title: A Watcher Eye
steps.body: Stop the game and place a Watcher Eye 9 studs ahead and 6 to the right. It turns slowly and looks about. When it sees you (nothing in the way), its eye glows for a moment while it charges, then it fires a beam that burns. A wall between you blocks the beam, and so does a shield held toward it.

steps.title: Block the beam
steps.body: Press Play and stand in front of the Watcher Eye. When its eye starts to glow, hold Q facing it: the shield takes the beam, though holding it costs stamina.
steps.task: Press Play and block the beam with the shield.

steps.title: A Lanternwisp
steps.body: Stop the game. Place the Lens of Truth to the left of the start and a Lanternwisp 9 studs ahead and 6 to the left. The Lanternwisp chases you for a while, then fades out and drifts round behind you. Faded, your sword goes through it and you cannot lock on to it.
steps.task: Place the Lens of Truth and a Lanternwisp.

steps.title: See it and strike
steps.body: Press Play, pick up the Lens and press its button to hold it up. Through the Lens a faded Lanternwisp shows as a faint outline, and now the sword hits it. Find it (it likes to be behind you) and strike.
steps.task: Press Play and strike the Lanternwisp through the Lens.

steps.title: A pack of Howlers
steps.body: Stop the game and place three Howlers 14 studs ahead. The first to see you howls and calls the rest. They circle you, keeping a ring, and only one comes in to bite at a time; swing at one in front and it hops back. Press Play and walk toward them.
steps.task: Place three Howlers, press Play and hear them howl.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You bounced a rock back, blocked a beam, struck a ghost through the Lens and met a hunting pack. The rest fight their own way too: Cinderjaw breathes fire close up (water puts you out), Flitterwings swoop down, a Threadback drops off its thread as you pass under, Rattlebones counters a swing at its front (get round it), a Finspitter spits fireballs from the water. Help › Enemies in play has them all.
